verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.langchain.com covering LangSmith documentation. Docs pages are also served as Markdown (.md) with a header pointing agents to the llms.txt index, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the agent-docs offering itself (e.g., an llms-full.txt variant or usage guidance) beyond what the probes observed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.langchain.com/llms.txt # Docs by LangChain
